about.heading: Meticulous. Trustworthy. Yours.
body: Kelsey O'Brien founded Maid & Marble to bring hotel-level attention to homes across Central Massachusetts — Worcester County, MetroWest, and towns along the I-495 corridor. Consistent crews, clear communication, and finishes that feel as polished as marble.

You work directly with Kelsey. She walks through your home, agrees on scope and frequency, and shows up ready to deliver. Licensed and insured. No surprise upsells — just reliable, detail-oriented cleaning.
